propositions: Committed operational script must rewrite the tickets branch using stock Git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) without new dependencies, removing .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes while preserving DAG topology and commit/merge counts.

Dry-run must execute only on a fresh unfiltered clone with --no-tags flag and refuse execution on partial blob:none clones, asserting .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ is absent from old-tip before rewrite begins.

After rewrite and dynamic re-add of .bridge_state/ files derived from ls-tree, the rewritten branch HEAD tree must be byte-identical to the original, with target prefixes stripped from all historical revisions.

Script must parse fast-export data blocks by byte length to correctly handle adversarial commit messages beginning with M or D, and must leave source remote branch and protected tag refs/tags/pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z unchanged.

Dry-run produces no remote push operations, performs no publication, and completes all graph/tree/history/tag/pack assertions before emitting final success; incremental writer push after rewrite must fit within <1 MiB and demonstrate old-tip is not an ancestor.
